field.label: Enable Custom Checkout Step
field.comment: Show the INSEAD financing / billing / tax step in checkout. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Gender Field
field.comment: Show the Gender field on the Billing Information step, per profile. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Nationality Field
field.comment: Show the Nationality field on the Billing Information step, per profile. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Phone Field
field.comment: Show the Phone field on the Billing Information step, per profile. If a profile is unchecked here, the "Phone Required" setting below has no effect for it — a hidden field is never required. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Phone Required
field.comment: Whether the Phone field is mandatory on the Billing Information step, per profile. Unchecked = optional for that profile. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Optional Tax & Legal Fields
field.comment: Which OPTIONAL Tax & Legal Information fields to show, across every country/tax-status combination they'd otherwise appear in. Unchecked by default — only mandatory fields and PO Number show out of the box. Mandatory fields (marked with *) are never affected by this setting; they always show. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Commercial Company Name
field.comment: Show the Commercial Company Name field in Organisation Details (Sponsored by Organisation only). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Commercial Company Name Required
field.comment: Whether Commercial Company Name is mandatory. Has no effect if Show Commercial Company Name above is No — a hidden field is never required. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Organisation Type
field.comment: Show the Organisation Type field in Organisation Details (Sponsored by Organisation only). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Organisation Type Required
field.comment: Whether Organisation Type is mandatory. Has no effect if Show Organisation Type above is No. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Job Industry
field.comment: Show the Job Industry field in Organisation Details (Sponsored by Organisation only). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Job Industry Required
field.comment: Whether Job Industry is mandatory. Has no effect if Show Job Industry above is No. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Job Industry Code Overrides (JSON)
field.comment: Optional. Maps the 3rd-party Sector of activity code to a Job Industry label from the checkout dropdown, e.g. {"94": "Airlines/Aviation", "125": "Alternative Medicine"}. Entries here replace the built-in mapping for the same code; codes not listed keep the built-in mapping. Leave empty to use the built-in mapping only.

field.label: Show TRN (UAE)
field.comment: Show the TRN field in Tax & Legal Information for UAE. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: TRN Required (UAE)
field.comment: Whether TRN is mandatory for UAE. Has no effect if Show TRN above is No. Configurable per website / store view.

group.label: VAT / Tax Customer Group Mapping
group.comment: Which customer group to switch the quote to during tax calculation, based on the B2C/B2B financing profile and B2B Tax Status alone (Registered/Non-Registered/Exempt) — the same shape as Singapore GST Customer Group Mapping below. Does NOT check EU-vs-non-EU country, VIES VAT-number validity, or a supporting letter — see Model\Vat\CustomerGroupResolver's docblock for the compliance note. Nothing in this section has anything to do with Singapore GST — that is a completely separate mechanism, configured below.

group.label: Singapore GST Customer Group Mapping
group.comment: Which of 6 customer groups to assign on the quote, based on the B2C/B2B financing profile, the Self-funded Singapore residency declaration, B2B Tax Status, and the B2B GST Declaration. Each group maps to its own Magento Tax Class — GST/reverse-charge/zero-rate treatment is calculated by native Tax Rules keyed to that Tax Class, not by any custom total. See Model\Gst\CustomerGroupResolver.

field.label: Enable Singapore GST
field.comment: Single flag for Singapore GST end to end: set to Yes ONLY at the scope of the Singapore selling-entity store(s) (e.g. lhub_sgp). Controls BOTH whether the GST Declaration / residency declaration fields render on the Billing Information step AND the backend customer-group assignment. Mutually exclusive with the VAT / Tax Customer Group Mapping above — a store should use one mechanism or the other, never both.

field.label: B2B, Singapore GST Liable
field.comment: Overrides Registered/Non-Registered/Exempt above — reached whenever the GST Declaration below is answered with a liable statement, regardless of Tax Status.

field.label: B2B, GST Declaration — Which Statements Move the Customer to Singapore GST Liable
field.comment: Select which of the 4 GST Declaration statements move a B2B customer into the "B2B, Singapore GST Liable" group above. Defaults to statement 4 ("None of the above apply") only — its own form text states selecting it results in a Singapore-GST invoice; statements 1-3 do not. See Model\Gst\CustomerGroupResolver.

field.label: Enable SIRET Auto-Fill
field.comment: Looks up the company legal name, trade name and postal address from the INSEE Sirene API once a valid 14-digit SIRET is entered on the France billing form.

field.label: INSEE API Key
field.comment: Value of the X-INSEE-Api-Key-Integration header, issued via your INSEE api.insee.fr application.

field.label: INSEE Sirene API Base URL
field.comment: E.g. https://api.insee.fr/api-sirene/3.11 — change only if INSEE ships a new API version.
